## Walkthrough

The changes introduce a new daily reward system to the game. This includes backend modules for managing daily rewards, API endpoints and controllers for claiming and retrieving rewards, OpenAPI schemas, admin LiveView for monitoring player rewards, scheduled reward imports from Google Sheets, and updates to the router and configuration. HTTP collection files for testing the new endpoints are also added.

## Changes

| File(s)                                                                                      | Change Summary                                                                                                 |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| lib/zombies_game/daily_reward.ex                                                            | New module implementing daily reward logic, reward claiming, caching, spreadsheet import, and config helpers.  |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/daily_reward_controller.ex                                 | New controller for daily reward API: listing and claiming rewards for the current player.                      |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/daily_reward_json.ex                                       | New JSON view module for formatting daily reward data for API responses.                                       |
| lib/zombies_game_web/schemas/daily_reward_schema.ex                                         | New OpenAPI schemas for daily reward event data and claim requests.                                            |
| lib/zombies_game_web/live/admin/daily_reward_live.ex                                        | New admin LiveView for displaying a player's daily reward progress and claims.                                 |
| lib/zombies_game/leaderboards.ex                                                            | Added "daily_reward" event type to leaderboards map; aliased DailyReward module.                              |
| lib/zombies_game/leaderboards/supervisor.ex                                                 | Added "daily_reward" event server to the supervisor's child list.                                              |
| lib/zombies_game_web/router.ex                                                              | Added API and admin routes for daily reward endpoints and LiveView.                                            |
| config/config.exs                                                                           | Added config for daily reward spreadsheet, sheet, range, and scheduled import job.                             |
| http-collection/DailyReward/Get the current player Daily Reward data.bru                    | New HTTP request for getting current player's daily reward data.                                               |
| http-collection/DailyReward/Claims a Daily Reward level for the current player.bru          | New HTTP request for claiming a daily reward for a specific day/level.                                         |
| http-collection/Auth/create-user.bru                                                        | New HTTP request for creating a guest user and extracting API key.                                             |
| mix.exs                                                                                     | Updated Docker Compose commands in aliases to use `docker compose` syntax.                                     |

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant API
    participant DailyRewardController
    participant DailyReward
    participant DB

    User->>API: GET /api/daily-reward (with apiKey)
    API->>DailyRewardController: index(conn, params)
    DailyRewardController->>DailyReward: get_player_daily_reward(player)
    DailyReward->>DB: Fetch daily reward record
    DailyRewardController->>DailyReward: get_rewards()
    DailyReward->>Cachex/DB: Fetch/cached rewards
    DailyRewardController->>API: Render JSON response

    User->>API: POST /api/daily-reward/claim (with apiKey, day)
    API->>DailyRewardController: claim(conn, params)
    DailyRewardController->>DailyReward: claim(record, player, day, day_rewards)
    DailyReward->>DB: Transaction: update record, inventory
    DailyRewardController->>API: Render JSON response
```

## Poem

> A new reward blooms with the dawn,  
> Seven days of gifts to fawn!  
> Claim your prize, don’t be late,  
> Rabbits cheer as you celebrate.  
> From sheets imported, treasures stored—  
> Hop along, collect your reward!  
> 🥕✨

<!-- walkthrough_end -->

## Walkthrough

The daily reward system was refactored to use time-based cooldowns and streak resets, removing manual day selection. The backend now determines claim eligibility and the next claimable day based on the player's last claim, updating metadata accordingly. Request and response schemas, controller logic, and UI rendering were updated to reflect these changes.

## Changes

| File(s)                                                                                   | Change Summary                                                                                                   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| http-collection/Auth/create-user.bru                                                     | Post-response script now sets "userId" and "guestSecret" as environment variables from the response body.        |
| http-collection/DailyReward/Claims a Daily Reward level for the current player.bru       | Removed the JSON request body; POST request now sends no payload.                                               |
| lib/zombies_game/daily_reward.ex                                                         | Added cooldown/reset constants, new time-based metadata, updated claim logic, and elapsed-minutes helper.        |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/daily_reward_controller.ex                              | Refactored claim logic: removed manual day input, now uses time-based eligibility and next claim day calculation.|
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/daily_reward_json.ex                                    | Refactored status rendering to use last claim metadata and new time-based logic for reward status calculation.  |
| lib/zombies_game_web/live/admin/daily_reward_live.ex                                     | Changed admin UI to display reward "type" instead of "name" in the rewards table.                               |
| lib/zombies_game_web/schemas/daily_reward_schema.ex                                      | Removed the daily reward request schema module; event schema remains unchanged.                                 |
| config/dev.exs, config/runtime.exs                                                       | Added configuration for daily reward feature enabling and cooldown/reset timing parameters from environment.   |
| zombies-game-cdk/lib/zombies-game-cdk-stack.ts                                          | Added environment variables for daily claim cooldown and streak reset minutes with different values per env.    |

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Player
    participant Controller
    participant DailyReward
    participant DB

    Player->>Controller: POST /claim_daily_reward
    Controller->>DB: Fetch player daily reward record
    Controller->>DailyReward: Check last_claimed_day, last_claim_at
    DailyReward-->>Controller: Calculate eligibility, next claimable day
    alt Eligible
        Controller->>DailyReward: claim(player, next_day, ...)
        DailyReward->>DB: Update last_claimed_day, last_claim_at
        Controller-->>Player: Return claimed rewards and updated status
    else Not eligible
        Controller-->>Player: Return "wait for cooldown" message
    end
```

## Poem

> Oh, the clock now ticks for daily treats,  
> No more picking days—just time-based feats!  
> Claim your reward when the minutes align,  
> The server keeps track—no more crossing the line.  
> Rabbits rejoice as the logic refines,  
> For streaks and cooldowns now govern the signs!  
> 🕰️🥕

<!-- walkthrough_end -->

## Walkthrough

The changes introduce explicit tracking of daily reward cycle completion using a new `cycle_completed` metadata flag. Configuration handling for cooldown and reset times is updated to consistently use string values. The JSON rendering logic is extended to reflect the new cycle completion state, affecting how reward day statuses are calculated and presented.

## Changes

| File(s)                                                                                  | Change Summary                                                                                                                        |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| config/dev.exs                                                                           | Changed environment variable handling for daily reward configuration: now uses string values with updated defaults, no integer parsing.|
| lib/zombies_game/daily_reward.ex                                                         | Changed config value types to strings; added `"cycle_completed"` flag to metadata; implemented logic to update this flag on claim.    |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/daily_reward_controller.ex                              | Modified error message to remove fixed "hours" suffix from cooldown value in JSON response.                                           |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/daily_reward_json.ex                                    | Added support for `cycle_completed` in reward JSON; updated status calculation logic; removed Logger debug statements.                |

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant DailyRewardController
    participant DailyReward
    participant DailyRewardJSON

    User->>DailyRewardController: Claim daily reward
    DailyRewardController->>DailyReward: claim(user_id, day, ...)
    DailyReward->>DailyReward: update_cycle_completion_flag(metadata, day)
    DailyReward-->>DailyRewardController: Updated record
    DailyRewardController->>DailyRewardJSON: show(%{record, rewards})
    DailyRewardJSON->>DailyRewardJSON: days(..., cycle_completed, ...)
    DailyRewardJSON->>DailyRewardJSON: calculate_status(..., cycle_completed)
    DailyRewardJSON-->>DailyRewardController: JSON response
    DailyRewardController-->>User: Response with updated reward status
```

## Poem

> A cycle now tracked, in metadata’s den,  
> With flags that flip when day seven’s again.  
> Cooldown and reset, as strings they appear,  
> JSON now knows when a cycle is clear.  
> The rabbit approves, with a hop and a cheer!  
> 🐇✨

<!-- walkthrough_end -->

## Walkthrough

A new "Chest Reward" feature was introduced, including backend logic, API endpoints, configuration, and OpenAPI schemas. The implementation enables players to view and claim chest rewards based on their progress, with reward data sourced from Google Sheets. The system integrates with leaderboards, schedules reward imports, and provides new HTTP endpoints and documentation. Additionally, daily reward claims now update chest reward claim tracking.

## Changes

| File(s)                                                                                       | Change Summary                                                                                       |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| config/config.exs                                                                             | Added config for ChestReward Google Sheets source and scheduled import job.                          |
| http-collection/ChestReward/*.bru                                                             | Added GET and POST HTTP request collections for fetching and claiming chest rewards.                 |
| lib/zombies_game/chest_reward.ex                                                              | New module: business logic for chest rewards (claiming, progress, importing rewards, etc.).          |
| lib/zombies_game/leaderboards.ex                                                              | Added "chest_reward" event to default leaderboards.                                                  |
| lib/zombies_game/leaderboards/supervisor.ex                                                   | Added "chest_reward" event server to supervisor's children.                                          |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/chest_reward_controller.ex                                   | New controller: GET and POST endpoints for chest reward data and claiming.                           |
| lib/zombies_game_web/controllers/chest_reward_json.ex                                         | New JSON view module: formats chest reward data for API responses.                                   |
| lib/zombies_game_web/router.ex                                                                | Added routes for chest reward endpoints under "/api/chest-reward".                                   |
| lib/zombies_game_web/schemas/chest_reward_schema.ex                                           | New OpenAPI schema module for chest reward event data.                                               |
| lib/zombies_game/daily_reward.ex                                                              | Modified claim/4 to update chest reward claimed days after daily reward claim.                       |

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Player
    participant API as ChestRewardController
    participant Logic as ChestReward
    participant DB as Database
    participant Sheets as Google Sheets

    Player->>API: GET /api/chest-reward
    API->>Logic: get_player_chest_reward(player)
    Logic->>DB: Fetch chest reward record
    Logic->>Logic: get_rewards()
    Logic->>Sheets: (if needed) Fetch rewards from spreadsheet
```
